Smoldyn particles bounded by vertex cells

A particle simulator composed with a multicellular one: each vertex cell is a moving boundary, and a Smoldyn sim runs inside each one — particles reflect off the cell boundary and react (A + B ⇌ C). Particles are coloured by their cell (matching the outline); on division a cell's molecules split into the two daughters. cell 1cell 2cell 3cell 4cell 1.1cell 1.2
